title: Finite-level scalar comparison data for an open quotient
statement: structure FiniteScalarLevelData (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j) (n : ℕ) where level : ∀ M : normalizedDVRModules l E U n, scalarReductionRestriction l E X n.obj ((IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o n).obj M) ≅ (scalarReductionRestriction l E U n ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.extension l E j o).obj M; naturality : ∀ {M N} (f : M ⟶ N), ((IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o n ⋙ scalarReductionRestriction l E X n).map f) ≫ (level N).hom = (level M).hom ≫ (scalarReductionRestriction l E U n ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.extension l E j o).map f. The structure is nonempty for every n.

source.place: Tags 03DI and 0E8I; identity on extension-by-zero generators and coefficient projection transport.

proof.text: Construct the comparison on extension-by-zero summands by the identity on sections, transport it through the finite coefficient projection, and use the scalar-extension and open-extension adjunctions to extend uniquely. Naturality follows from the same generator formula.
